category_edits.rationale: Apply parameter-free LayerNorm to history item embeddings before dropout and the GRU, explicitly preserving zero padding. This may stabilize recurrent input scales while preserving embedding dimensions, candidate scoring, GRU topology, loss, and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the updated GRU4RecModel directly, so inference uses the same normalization without checkpoint changes.

def forward(self, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor):

change_summary: Normalize GRU input embeddings with parameter-free LayerNorm in training and inference, preserving zero padding and unchanged candidate embeddings. Retain one model per category and all existing training settings.
